text: S6 hash-drift root cause (docs/verification/phrf-cmp-reconciliation-20261010/s6-hash-drift-investigation.md): pin 575a7482 was made and last passed on the pre-migration host (Darwin temp dir 9h/nkjq6vss..., in the 10-01 install.log and 10-05 gate log; absent here). This host is an M2 Pro on macOS 15.1.1. The lock's numpy/scipy link the system Accelerate, which is outside the lock. Thread pins have no effect: hash 398d45a2 is the same pinned, unpinned and with VECLIB=8. A same-host Accelerate vs OpenBLAS swap shows the class: HRFindex, FRAC, pool and pcnum identical; betas differ at float32 level (rel L2 <= 3.3e-6). This is a host/BLAS change, not a semantic one. Pin unchanged. GlmSingleBridgeSuite 33/35 (the 2 pin tests fail). S6 stays open pending owner choice: host-profile-qualified pin (recommended), OpenBLAS + OPENBLAS_CORETYPE lock with requalification, or a canonicalized assertion (loosening).
